articles.title: Gloria Steinem, feminist icon, dies at 92
articles.dek: Gloria Steinem, the journalist, activist and organizer who became the most recognizable face of the U.S. women's movement, died Wednesday at 92. The big picture: Steinem resisted being cast as feminism's singular face, but for six decades she carried its ideas into mainstream America across its second and third waves. Steinem made the personal political: An illegal abortion at 22 preceded decades of fighting first to legalize abortion and then to defend that right. articles.dek: Feminist icon Gloria Steinem has died at the age of 92. Steinem co-founded Ms. magazine, the first major publication to be owned, run and written by women. She also helped found the National Women’s Political Caucus with a group of women including Shirley Chisholm, Betty Friedan and Fannie Lou Hamer.
